snippet.title: Cat & Farm Pals - Trailer
snippet.description:
EN: Cat & Farm Pals is a simple and fun toss-and-throw game that you can enjoy. Spend quality time with cats and farm animals, compete in weekly tournaments, and collect trophies!

TR: Cat & Farm Pals keyifle oynayabileceğiniz basit ve eğlenceli bir çek-fırlat oyunudur. Kediler ve çiftlik hayvanlarıyla keyifli vakit geçirin, haftalık turnuvalarda rekabet edin ve kupaları toplayın!

Cat&Farm Pals on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3181470/Cat__Farm_Pals/
